name: Meditate on This!

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

prerequisites: trained in Medicine or Tian Xia Lore
text:
Access Tian Xia origin

---
You meditate to alter your qi, coloring it with your resentment and anger. Until the start of your next turn, whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed Strike, or an adjacent creature deals piercing, slashing, or bleed damage to you, the creature that you hit or that damaged you must attempt a Will save save against your class DC. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 3 and Fleeing until the end of its next turn.
